name: Tear Pad
summary: A delivery date picker with a tear-off desk calendar that rips pages to reach your day
about: A date field and month grid for picking a delivery day, next to a paper tear-off calendar. Pick a later day and the pad tears off pages one after another, faster and faster, until it shows your date; pick an earlier one and pages fly back on. A red blob stretches between days in the grid, and setting the date draws a pen circle and stamps the page.
how: Click a day in the grid, or type a date like 26/11/2026 in the field and press Enter
Sundays and past days are blocked: they shake and the hint explains why
Use the arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up and Page Down to move through the grid
Watch the pad tear pages forward or stick them back on until it shows your day
Press Set delivery date to circle the day and stamp it
